feeds.title: The Nashville Mom
feeds.description: The Nashville Mom is a place for families to connect with kid friendly events, restaurants and things to do in Nashville! Dawn and her family love exploring all things Nashville and sharing their adventures!

feeds.title: Music City Moms Blog
feeds.description: Music City Moms is an online community for parents in Middle Tennessee. This is the place where Nashville area moms connect. We have a great group of moms to answer questions, give advice, or just listen.

feeds.title: Summer's Sweet Shoppe Blog
feeds.description: Hi, Y'all! I'm Summer a self-taught cookie baker and decorator in Nashville, Tennessee. I am the owner of Summer's Sweet Shoppe, and I have recently launched Summer's Cookie Academy and Cookie Club! For the past 10 years, I have mastered the art of cookie decorating.

feeds.title: Nashville Wifestyles
feeds.description: Nashville Wifestyles is a Nashville Style Blog written by Ashley in which she talks about the latest trends, mom tips, and more. Ashley is a lover of anything beauty, fashion, or food. She plans on this being a lifestyle blog mainly because calling it a smorgasbord of all things I love just didn't sound as appealing or professional.

feeds.title: Sami Cone
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Sami! Whether you've read my best-selling book or seen me on TV, I'm glad you found me here. As a Nashville wife and mom to two teenagers, I look forward to helping you live your best life on less & achieve your dreams!

feeds.title: Nashville Baby Guide
feeds.description: From Nashville family photographers, birthday party, and baby shower planners to local kids boutiques and more find everything you need for your kids and baby in the Nashville Baby Guide business directory.

feeds.title: Hello Happiness Blog
feeds.description: I'm Natasha, a thirty-something native Nashvillian, with a fondness for all things southern. I am a life and style blogger. Hello Happiness has been my creative outlet and daily diary for almost 14 years and it's how I choose to document life's milestones, celebrations, and everyday musings of my family and business.

feeds.title: Jenny Cruger Photography Blog
feeds.description: Jenny Cruger established the simple. pure. organic. brand of motherhood photography, creating the idea of organic portraits for maternity, newborn, baby, and family sessions beginning in 2010 in the Nashville area, and went on to train top photographers across the country, including those in Texas, California, Atlanta and beyond, in creating a complete experience for clients from the beginning with planning sessions, studio wardrobes, and intimate moments between moms, dads, and their tiniest loves, to ending with luxury heirloom artwork in their homes.

feeds.title: Twila's Photography Blog
feeds.description: Twila is a seasoned wedding photographer with over 15 years of wedding photography experience. She offers a very custom approach to her couples and families. A wife and mother herself, she knows the importance and meaning of cherished photos and the role photography plays in a family's history.

feeds.title: Hunter Premo Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Hunter. I'm a fashion and lifestyle influencer with a serious love for vintage style and all things boho with a little edge mixed in! I'm a fashion and lifestyle influencer. I'm a homegrown Nashville girl who's all about the little things in life, whether I'm hunting for vintage finds, spending time with family and friends, or planning my next outdoor adventure.

feeds.title: KB Styled
feeds.description: Hi friends! Brooke Webb here, the gal behind KBStyled, a style & lifestyle brand dedicated to the modern everyday woman. I hope that KBStyled will be a source of inspiration and encouragement as well as a fun place to spend your time.

feeds.title: Living With Landyn
feeds.description: I am Landyn. I'm a working mama with two kids, still trying to find that work/mom/wife balance. My hope is to inspire you in this crazy life, be your daily dose of comic relief, and be the best girlfriend you never really knew you needed.

feeds.title: Something Totally Different
feeds.description: I'm Lindsay Ferrier, a Nashville wife, and mother with a passion for family travel, (mostly) healthy cooking, exploring Tennessee, and raising kids without losing my mind in the process. This is where I share my discoveries with you, along with occasional deep thoughts, pop culture tangents, and a sprinkling of snark.

feeds.title: The Sometimes Glam Wife
feeds.description: My name is Brandi and I am a lifestyle blogger from Nashville, TN. I have spent the majority of my life living in Nashville with my husband. We met back in 2008 and got married shortly after in 2010. We moved away from Nashville in 2012 but ended up moving back in 2018 when our son was born. The purpose of this blog is to connect with other moms around the world and share my experiences with everyone.

feeds.title: Courtney Kinchen Blog
feeds.description: Hi there! I'm Courtney, and I'm beyond excited you stopped by to see my life outside of Instagram! I created this blog as a way to keep you updated on my life and to share my love of fashion with you! My goal for this blog is not only to share affordable fashion with you but to be an uplifting presence in your daily life! I'm truly excited you are here and hope you love the things I have to share!

feeds.title: Nashville Wife
feeds.description: My name is Ellie, and my husband is Mr. Handsome. Of course, that's not the name on his birth certificate, but I'm into nicknames. We call our oldest son born in 2019 Little Buddy. Three years later, we welcomed another son. We call him Littlest Buddy. We have been married since 2015, so my blog archive features plenty of posts about our DIY, 300-guest wedding, which we planned in three short months.

feeds.title: Nashville Nanny Agency Blog
feeds.description: Established in 2014, Nashville Nanny Agency is an exclusive boutique agency that serves families who want safe, reliable, loving care, and also understands the need for a stable, long-term professional partnership with an agency that will meet their family's needs as their children grow.

feeds.title: My WAHM Plan
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Linda, a happy Nashville, TN, WAHM of two Gen Z daughters, celebrating 20+ years of working at home, with over 10 years of that right here on this blog. I like strong coffee, being outside (especially at sunset), beautiful flowerbeds (sometimes they're mine), happy kids, happy bellies, (home-style cooking is my jam), a welcoming home, and a thriving home-based business. I'm sharing all my tips & ideas for a happy home life.
